channel.title: DOOMCON — index moves
channel.description: Every AI doom number is a judgement call. This one is arithmetic: how much is happening in AI, measured hourly from public data — not how bad it is. Five pillars, one 0-100 score, one level from 5 (quietest) to 1 (loudest), and every number reproducible from a published receipt.

item.title: DOOMCON 4 · 55.5 (+14.3)
item.description: Score 41.2 to 55.5 (+14.3) at 2026-10-03 17:29:23 UTC. DOOMCON measures how much is happening, not how bad it is. Levels run from 5 (quietest) to 1 (loudest) and describe observable activity tempo against this index’s own record. They are not a probability of harm.
